# Spaceezy

> Spaceezy is a real-estate firm that helps buyers discover, shortlist and enquire about residential properties and builder projects in Wave City, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh. The website publishes current prices, configurations and availability so visitors can compare options before contacting the team.

## About Spaceezy

- [About Spaceezy](https://spaceezy.com/about): Company story, leadership and values. Spaceezy was founded to make finding a home more transparent, with curated options, honest advice and end-to-end support.
- The website states zero brokerage on partner and new developer projects, dedicated relationship managers for site visits, legal and documentation assistance, and post-sales support. Listings are described as verified and project pages show RERA details where available.
- Gaurav Sharma is listed as Chief Executive Officer and Kamal as Founder.
- Spaceezy uses an internal CRM to manage enquiries, inventory, follow-ups and site visits; the CRM is an operational tool, not a publicly marketed software product.

## Real Estate Services

- [Property buying assistance](https://spaceezy.com/property-buying-assistance): How Spaceezy helps buyers discover, shortlist and enquire about published homes and projects.
- [Property enquiries](https://spaceezy.com/property-enquiries): How to enquire about a project or unit, what details help the team respond and how enquiries lead to next steps.
- [Site visits](https://spaceezy.com/site-visits): How to request a visit, where properties are located and what buyers should prepare.
- [Browse published projects](https://spaceezy.com/projects): Builder projects with pricing, configurations, amenities, RERA details and availability.
- [Browse published properties](https://spaceezy.com/properties): Individual residential units with price, area, configuration and availability status.

## Projects & Properties

- [Eligo Wave City](https://spaceezy.com/projects/eligo-wave-city-c28c62): Residential project by Wave Group / Wave Infratech in Wave City, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, with 3 BHK configurations and RERA information.
- [Dream Homes](https://spaceezy.com/projects/dream-homes-e84e51): Residential project by Wave Group in Wave City, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, with 1 BHK, 2 BHK and 3 BHK configurations and RERA information.
- [Eligo Wave City Tower 1 a302](https://spaceezy.com/properties/1c8bb75583bf3d60ee4ef27d02cd13ab): Published 3 BHK unit with area, price, amenities and availability details.
- [Flats in Wave City](https://spaceezy.com/flats-in-wave-city): Residential listings published in Wave City.
- [1 BHK Flats in Wave City](https://spaceezy.com/1-bhk-flats-in-wave-city): 1 BHK residential listings published in Wave City.

## Areas Served

The website and company details list Wave City, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh as the served area. The published projects and office are located there. Spaceezy does not publish separate location doorway pages.
